messages:
Jess: Quick ask — NovaMetrics POC starts tomorrow, heavy embedding workload, spiky. They want a temporary per-token override for hosted embeddings for 30 days and a min-charge waiver. Can we approve? Details below.
Jess: TL;DR: expected first-month usage ~50M embedding tokens (mostly inference), spikes to 8-12M tokens/day. They’re sensitive to unit cost. Request = $0.45 / 1k embedding tokens (vs standard $0.60) for 30 days, no min charge for the POC. No commit. Need decision in 24h to finalize POC contract.
Olivia: what’s the expected ARR if this goes to prod? need to weigh $$ impact.
Jess: Short answer: if prod converts, conservative ARR estimate $300k-500k ARR in year 1. Sales says deal motion and PAC already promising pilot -> paid pilot likely in Q3.
Sam: technical: embeddings are highly cacheable for our use-case? Not really — it's a vector-first analytics app, lots of unique queries. Batching helps but not enough for big spikes.
Sam: ops note: we can apply a promo code on hosted API for 30 days, no infra changes. Also suggest prefix KV caching + per-request batching to lower effective cost.
Mike: @Jess please put the ask in the Deal Desk template: ask, duration, expected ARR, rollback plan, finance impact. Also include a brief clause for reversion to list pricing after 30d.
Jess: putting here the minimal rollback language: "pricing override expires at UTC 2026-05-20T00:00Z; charges revert to list rate unless signed commit is in place." ok?
Liza: CS recs: propose either (A) $15k trial credit + soft per-token cap at $0.55, or (B) full per-token override to $0.45 but cap monthly spend at $25k. Both reduce downside.
Olivia: finance input: if we do $0.45 uncap, it could be ~ $22.5k cost in month 1 before markup? need exact numbers from billing.
billing-bot: Promo created: CODE=POC-NOVAMETA-30D, scope=hosted.embeddings, override_rate=$0.45/1k, expires=30d (provisioned but NOT active until deal desk sign-off).
Mike: I can approve the $0.45 override conditional on: 1) Deal Desk form submitted, 2) Finance signoff on projected P&L, 3) Legal ok on rollback clause. If they prefer credit + soft cap, that’s likely auto-approved faster.
Jess: thanks — I'll fill the form, attach projected usage, and ping finance. If finance is slow we'll offer Liza’s option A instead.
Liza: I'll draft the customer message + docs for how usage is metered during promo. Keep me looped.
Olivia: ping me when numbers are in. If ARR estimate holds we should fast-track.
Mike: @billing-bot please hold activation until I confirm.
billing-bot: Activation held: POC-NOVAMETA-30D pending human approval.
Jess: on it. will update in this thread within 6 hours. :thumbsup:
